title: Interactive sessions share one kbmon snapshot, so N panes cost about one refresh, not N
goal: python3 _tools/kbmon.py --once --shared --max-age S serves the frame from a snapshot under the clone's _cache (one per clone, written under a lock so two due panes make one refresh) when the snapshot is younger than S seconds, says in its output that it is the shared snapshot and its age, and runs a fresh --once and rewrites the snapshot otherwise (--max-age 0 always refreshes); and the kbmon-pane mod's refresh passes --shared with its REFRESH_MS as the max age

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import subprocess, time
def once(*extra):
    t = time.perf_counter()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/kbmon.py', '--once', '--shared', *extra], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=300)
    return p, time.perf_counter() - t
p0, _ = once('--max-age', '0')
assert p0.returncode in (0, 1), ('kbmon --once --shared --max-age 0 exit', p0.returncode, p0.stderr[-300:])
p1, t1 = once('--max-age', '0')
p2, t2 = once('--max-age', '600')
assert p2.returncode in (0, 1), ('kbmon --once --shared exit', p2.returncode, p2.stderr[-300:])
assert t2 < 2.0 and t2 * 3 < t1, ('a second pane refresh inside --max-age reads no shared snapshot', round(t1, 2), round(t2, 2))
assert 'shared' in (p2.stdout + p2.stderr), 'the served frame does not say it came from the shared snapshot'
p3, t3 = once('--max-age', '0')
assert t3 > t2 * 3, ('--max-age 0 serves the snapshot instead of a fresh run', round(t2, 2), round(t3, 2))
mod = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-c', "import re,sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kbmon-pane/hooks/register.tsx',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if re.search(r'--shared', t) else 1)"])
assert mod.returncode == 0, 'the kbmon-pane mod does not pass --shared to its refresh'

clauses.clause: python3 _tools/kbmon.py --once --shared --max-age S serves the frame from a snapshot under the clone's _cache (one per clone, written under a lock so two due panes make one refresh) when the snapshot is younger than S seconds, says in its output that it is the shared snapshot and its age
runs a fresh --once and rewrites the snapshot otherwise (--max-age 0 always refreshes)
and the kbmon-pane mod's refresh passes --shared with its REFRESH_MS as the max age

notes: Premise, measured in SP-3qowbedb's record: one kbmon.py --once of the pane costs about 8 CPU seconds and 690-730 MB peak (session-load arm B, 3 refreshes in a 150 s window), and each interactive session runs it every 60 s on its own; the reviewer measured one --once at 10.8 s user CPU and 493 MB under /usr/bin/time -l at load about 6. Arm B of session-load measures the saving. The notices the mod derives from a frame (needs-you rows, alert receipts) stay per session; the review reads register.tsx's diff for it.
